project.name: Sandbox Arch Rules
project.description: Shared ArchUnit rule module depended on by every service's test suite, so Hexagonal-layer, bounded-context, and outbox-isolation rules stay consistent across services and a teammate plugging in their own producer/consumer gets the rules "for free". Empty ruleset for now (M0) - real rules are added starting M2 once order-service exists to enforce structure against, and are hardened in M10. Not over-specified early: only rules that map to an actual correctness property get added, as real violations are noticed.
